device_name: Tritanium TL Curved Posterior Lumbar Cage
what_it_is: Hollow curved posterior lumbar interbody cage built using AMagine additive manufacturing technology. Features Tritanium In-Growth Technology porous structure designed for bone in-growth and biological fixation. Unique randomized pore shape and sizing mimic cancellous bone with interconnected pore structure from endplate to endplate. Curved shape with roughened Tritanium surface featuring multi-directional teeth provides tactile feedback during placement.
sizing_specs: Available in a variety of heights, lengths, and lordotic angles. Two inserter and two tamp options for open and MIS procedures.
compatible_with: Tritanium PL (complementary posterior lumbar solution). Anterior Placement System.
use_notes: Anterior Placement System enables apophyseal placement. Designed for versatility in open and MIS procedures. Imaging-compatible. Developed to minimize subsidence. Now sold by VB Spine.
